claims.text: The hotel is at Paseo de Gracia 68-70, 08007 Barcelona.

findings.quote: Paseo de Gracia, 68 - 70, 08007, Barcelona, España

claims.text: The hotel is a block away from Gaudí's La Pedrera (Casa Milà).

findings.quote: Just a block away from **Gaudí’s world-famous La Pedrera (Casa Milà)**

claims.text: The Majestic is over 100 years old.

findings.quote: The Majestic is over 100 years old

claims.text: Fish for Restaurant SOLC comes daily from the Barcelona fish market.

findings.quote: The menu is completed by fish brought in daily from the Barcelona fish market

claims.text: SOLC serves a gourmet brunch every Sunday.

findings.quote: A reimagined culinary date to enjoy every Sunday.
SOLC's Gourmet Brunch has quickly become a classic on Sundays in Barcelona.

claims.text: Chef David Romero devised the SOLC Gourmet Brunch, which follows SOLC's farm-to-table concept.

findings.quote: This formula devised by our chef David Romero offers a proposal that follows the "Farm to Table" concept of SOLC Restaurant.

claims.text: A pianist plays in El Bar del Majestic several evenings a week.

findings.quote: the menu created by the chef David Romero and the pianist who livens up the evenings several days a week
findings.note: in El Bar del Majestic section

claims.text: The wellness area has a heated pool and a hydromassage pool.

findings.quote: Our exclusive space features a 12-meter heated pool and a 20m² hydromassage pool

claims.text: The spa is on the highest floor of the building.

findings.quote: Located on the highest floor of the building, an excellent team of professionals

claims.text: The Penthouse Suite has a private terrace with a solarium and panoramic views over Paseo de Gracia or the Sagrada Familia.

findings.quote: a private terrace with solarium and panoramic views overlooking Paseo de Gracia or La Sagrada Familia

claims.text: Privilege Family rooms sleep up to 3 adults or 2 adults and 2 children under 12, with a king bed and a sofa bed.

findings.quote: capacity for up to 3 adults or 2 adults and 2 children (under 12 years old), king size bed and sofa-bed

claims.text: A Rossano Ferretti HairSpa had its grand opening at the hotel on 9 October 2026.

findings.quote: ## New Rossano Ferretti HairSpa
Grand Opening: Friday, Octuber 9th, 2026

claims.text: The hotel has its own farm in the Maresme area, near the Mediterranean, which grows vegetables for Restaurant SOLC.

findings.quote: the establishment itself has a farm in the Maresme area (a few kilometres from the restaurant and just a few metres from the Mediterranean Sea) where the vegetables harvested daily that diners will find on the menu are grown

claims.text: La Dolce Vitae is a restaurant and bar on the hotel's rooftop terrace, with views of the Sagrada Familia, Casa Batlló and the Glòries Tower.

findings.quote: ## Rooftop 'La Dolce Vitae', Restaurant & Bar
La Dolce Vitae is the spectacular terrace located on the roof of the hotel
along with its most emblematic architectural icons such as the Sagrada Familia, Casa Batlló and the Glòries Tower

claims.text: Bathroom products are by Atelier Cologne, which also created the hotel's own scent, Musc Impérial.

findings.quote: The bathroom products are by the prestigious French Atelier Cologne, which has also developed the hotel’s bespoke scent, Musc Impérial.

claims.text: The Royal Penthouse includes a driver, luxury car, private butler and a private rooftop terrace with an outdoor jacuzzi.

findings.quote: includes access to exclusive services like a driver, luxury car and private butler, as well as a sprawling private rooftop terrace with an outdoor jacuzzi

claims.text: On summer nights the rooftop hosts the Majestic Sunset Sessions with a resident DJ and international guest DJs.

findings.quote: to the rhythm of the Majestic Sunset Sessions with our resident DJ and other recognized international DJs during the summer nights

claims.text: The hotel's apartments are at 69 Passeig de Gràcia, across from the hotel in a separate building.

findings.quote: Located at 69 de Passeig de Gràcia, in front of the hotel, but in an independent building.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the busy street location may bring some urban noise.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
